root_cause.text: The ASoC nau8821 driver fails to cancel or synchronize the pending jack detection delayed work (`jdet_work`) during component removal, allowing the work callback to execute and access resources after the driver has been unloaded.
root_cause.evidence: The patch introduces a `nau8821_component_remove` function that calls `cancel_delayed_work_sync(&nau8821->jdet_work)` and registers it in `nau8821_component_driver`, directly addressing the CVE description which states that unloading the driver while work is pending causes a kernel crash (page fault) when the work eventually executes.
